limitations: Counted inventory: 845 cases = 130 numbered model cases + 715 entries in Unlabeled/case_list.md (635 RAR archives and 80 cases inside Test (Cropped) ZIPs). Each Unlabeled record retains its case-list row number (1-715) separately from its source case ID/name.

Crop status: 210 cropped cases (130 Model cases and 80 Test (Cropped) ZIP members) and 635 not-cropped RAR-list cases. The 80 ZIP-member dataset splits remain unknown because their source folder name does not verify train/test assignment. Tags are available for future annotation and start empty.
The 80 Test (Cropped) cases are already included in the 715 unlabeled entries. Original labeled folders duplicate model cases and are excluded from the case count.
RAR archives and ZIP members are indexed from the case list; archive contents are not extracted. RAR split assignments remain unknown unless verified separately.
130 completed annotations were reported on 13 November 2026; this is not verified by the current ABC file inventory.
ABC segment names are candidate annotations, not professor approval. Historical geometry predictions remain separate.
Large scans, masks and archives stay in the project folder; this site carries their paths and lightweight previews.

project.stage: Phase 1 · Defect-site annotation and protocol review
project.summary: The current inventory contains 845 cases: 130 numbered model cases plus 715 entries from the Unlabeled case list. The 80 Test (Cropped) cases are already included in the 715; original labeled folders duplicate the model cases and are excluded.
project.next: Agree on the annotation and review protocol; establish raw-ID and split details for the 715 unlabeled source records; expand defect-site annotations; train and evaluate learned segmentation/ABC with anatomical models and rule-based measurements. Then implement and validate the clinical decision pathways.
project.source: Scope clarification and project handoff, 13 November 2026. 130 completed is user-reported and is separate from the file audit.

milestones.title: Historical anatomical segmentation baseline
milestones.detail: Training and test artifacts exist. These are historical anatomical masks, not confirmed ABC defect labels.

milestones.title: Panorama pipeline
milestones.detail: 118 improved training panoramas recorded in the 12 November update. Remaining cohorts need previews.

milestones.title: Defect-site annotation and protocol agreement
milestones.detail: Candidate ABC segments, uncertain cases and deferred multiple-defect cases need review.

milestones.title: Learned segmentation / ABC and derived measurements
milestones.detail: Learn defect sites and ABC with context; use pretrained anatomy and measurement rules for other characteristics, including I/II/III.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Clinical decision support
milestones.detail: Reference pathways exist; executable rules, required clinical inputs and validation remain to be agreed.

decisions.title: Confirm the ABC annotation protocol
decisions.question: Confirm regeneration-supporting wall interpretation and annotation examples for learned ABC. Define what idk represents and how it is handled during training and evaluation.

decisions.title: Agree on multiple-defect case representation
decisions.question: For deferred cases, define separate sites versus multiple components in one site, site IDs, and how decisions should be coordinated.

decisions.title: Approve measurement and anatomical boundaries
decisions.question: Confirm the width datum, aggregation, wall datum/rise, ROI boundaries for both jaws and limits of small-FOV geometry. Existing code defaults are not clinical sign-off.

decisions.title: Define clinician agreement review and dataset split
decisions.question: Select the clinician-reviewed subset, adjudication process and locked patient-level train/test split. Verify identity mappings and prevent duplicate cases crossing splits.

decisions.title: Complete the Phase 2 decision specification
decisions.question: Provide Table 4 / Section 6.7 definitions; agree on required non-CBCT inputs and whether output is a ranked shortlist or one preferred plan. No numeric thresholds should be inferred from qualitative diagram categories.

decisions.title: Confirm case ID crosswalk and annotation audit
decisions.question: Establish raw scan IDs and verified train/test splits for the 715 unlabeled source-list records, and reconcile the reported 130 completed annotations with observed ABC files. The case count is 130 model + 715 unlabeled; Test (Cropped) cases are included in the latter, and duplicate original labeled folders are excluded.
decisions.source: Current folder audit and project counting rule
